nodes.name: Find Sibling Path
nodes.notes: Looks up allKnownFiles for a sibling Project – file in the same folder. Outputs siblingPath (string or null).

nodes.name: Read Sibling File
nodes.notes: Fetches sibling Project – file content via Obsidian Local REST API

nodes.name: Parse Sibling Frontmatter
nodes.notes: Extracts project slug and area from sibling file frontmatter. Falls back to slugifying the filename if project key is absent.

nodes.name: Respond to Workflow
nodes.notes: Output: { siblingProjectSlug, siblingProjectArea }. Empty string means not found.
